eplb_update_time: 5000
redundant_expert: 0
hack_ep_single_entry: 0
balance_method: mix
eplb_force_repack: 0
eplb_stats_window_size: 10

[py_kv_cache_config]
int8_kv_cache: 0
fp8_kv_cache: 0
kv_cache_dtype: auto
kv_cache_mem_mb: -1
seq_size_per_block: 16
test_block_num: 0
use_block_cache: None

reuse_cache: False

[py_device_resource_config]

specify_gpu_arch: 
acext_gemm_config_dir: None
device_reserve_memory_bytes: -4096000000

[sparse_config]
sparse_config_file: None

[engine_config]
warm_up: 0
warm_up_with_loss: 0
max_seq_len: 32768

[embedding_config]
embedding_model: 0
extra_input_in_mm_embedding: 

[worker_config]
worker_info_port_num: 7

[role_config]
role_type: PDFUSION

[pd_separation_config]
prefill_retry_times: 0
prefill_retry_timeout_ms: 0
prefill_max_wait_timeout_ms: 600000
decode_retry_times: 100
decode_retry_timeout_ms: 100
decode_retry_interval_ms: 100
decode_polling_kv_cache_step_ms: 30
decode_entrance: 0
rdma_connect_retry_times: 0
load_cache_timeout_ms: 5000

[parallelism_distributed_config]
tp_size: 4
ep_size: 1
dp_size: 1
world_size: 4
world_rank: 0
pp_size: 1
local_world_size: 4
ffn_sp_size1

[model_specific_config]

load_python_model:0


[fmha_config]
enable_fmha: 1
enable_trt_fmha: 1
enable_paged_trt_fmha: 1
enable_open_source_fmha: 1
enable_paged_open_source_fmha: 1
enable_trtv1_fmha: 1
fmha_perf_instrument: 0
fmha_show_params: 0
disable_flash_infer: 0
enable_xqa: 1


[misc_config]
disable_pdl1
aux_string: 


[concurrency_config]
concurrency_with_block: 0
concurrency_limit: 1024

[jit_config]

[py_hw_kernel_config]

arm_gemm_use_kai: False
enable_stable_scatter_add: False

ft_disable_custom_ar: False

fp8_kv_cache: 0
kv_cache_dtype: auto
kv_cache_mem_mb: -1
seq_size_per_block: 16
test_block_num: 0
use_block_cache: None
blockwise_use_fp8_kv_cache: 0
reuse_cache: False

[py_device_resource_config]
reserver_runtime_mem_mb: 10240
specify_gpu_arch: 
acext_gemm_config_dir: None
device_reserve_memory_bytes: -4096000000

[sparse_config]
sparse_config_file: None

[engine_config]
warm_up: 0
warm_up_with_loss: 0
max_seq_len: 32768

[embedding_config]
embedding_model: 0
extra_input_in_mm_embedding: 

[worker_config]
worker_info_port_num: 7

[role_config]
role_type: PDFUSION

[pd_separation_config]
prefill_retry_times: 0
prefill_retry_timeout_ms: 0
prefill_max_wait_timeout_ms: 600000
decode_retry_times: 100
decode_retry_timeout_ms: 100
decode_retry_interval_ms: 100
decode_polling_kv_cache_step_ms: 30
decode_entrance: 0
rdma_connect_retry_times: 0
load_cache_timeout_ms: 5000

[parallelism_distributed_config]
tp_size: 4
ep_size: 1
dp_size: 1
world_size: 4
world_rank: 0
pp_size: 1
local_world_size: 1
ffn_sp_size1

[model_specific_config]

load_python_model:0


[fmha_config]
enable_fmha: 1
enable_trt_fmha: 1
enable_paged_trt_fmha: 1
enable_open_source_fmha: 1
enable_paged_open_source_fmha: 1
enable_trtv1_fmha: 1
fmha_perf_instrument: 0
fmha_show_params: 0
disable_flash_infer: 0
enable_xqa: 1


[misc_config]
disable_pdl1
aux_string: 


[concurrency_config]
concurrency_with_block: 0
concurrency_limit: 1024

[jit_config]
remote_jit_dir: 

[py_hw_kernel_config]
deep_gemm_num_sm: -1
arm_gemm_use_kai: False
enable_stable_scatter_add: False
enable_multi_block_mode: True
ft_disable_custom_ar: False
rocm_hipblaslt_config: gemm_config.csv
use_swizzleA: True
enable_cuda_graph: False
enable_cuda_graph_debug_mode: False
use_aiter_pa: True
